calculation.description: Fade each tradable asset's lagged 10-trading-day return following an unusually large positive 3-day VIX shock; otherwise emit zero. The VIX threshold is based only on its trailing 252 observations and the signal predicts the next 5 trading days.

signal.formula: factor[t,a] = -asset_return_10d[t,a] if VIX_return_3d[t] exceeds trailing 252d 70th percentile of absolute VIX 3d returns, else 0
signal.alignment: Signals use data through t and are evaluated against close[t+1:t+5]; no future data is used.

validation.regime_notes: Positive aggregate and strong 2031 performance, but negative 2028-2029 results show regime dependence; interpret cautiously given approximately 15-name cross-section.
